def pick(xs: list[int], seed: int) -> int:
    """Return the element of xs at index seed mod xs.len(), so the same seed always gives the same element."""
    pre xs.len() > 0
    post out in xs
    ex pick([10, 20, 30], 4) == 20
    ex pick([10, 20, 30], 0) == 10
    ex pick([7], 12345) == 7
    n = xs.len()
    idx = (seed % n + n) % n
    return xs[idx]
